Status Of Vibe Coded Apps 3 Months In

Like a lot of developers I started experimenting with Claude Code in late 2025. Since then I have vibe coded a lot of apps for personal use. Given it’s been almost 10 months I wanted to see which ones I do still use.

  • mochi-claude-code-gen - Mochi Flashcard generator with Claude Code.
  • cache-hit - Superseded by spaced. A spaced repetition application for reviewing coding problems.
  • geometric-art-generator - A macOS app that uses AI to generate stunning geometric art from simple text descriptions.
  • nee-reads - A very simple goodreads alternative for my wife, she never used it.
  • agent-sandbox - Manage Git worktrees per feature.
  • saas-ticker - Stock ticker to track see if death of Saas is real.
  • Fork of leaf - Markdown viewer, forked to change shortcuts
  • Fork of ghui - Superseded by review.nvim. TUI Github PR reviewer.
  • review.nvim - Neovim library to help do Github and local change reviews
  • wt - Agent worktree management TUI. Most used.
  • spaced - TUI spaced repetition app. 2nd most.
  • bookmarks - New. Replacement for pinboard.in.

Around 3 months ago, I started building more TUI apps with OpenTUI . I spend a lot of time in the terminal, so this made it easier to integrate it with my regular workflow.
